papers.title: Time to default in credit scoring using survival analysis: a benchmark study
papers.authors: Lore Dirick; Gerda Claeskens; Bart Baesens
papers.journal: Journal of the Operational Research Society68,652-665
papers.use: Censoring-aware historical loan-risk supervision. Interval bounds, borrower crossfit and 35-epoch Weibull neural model are our implementation choices.

papers.title: Multimodal Generative Models for Scalable Weakly-Supervised Learning
papers.use: Shared variational representation and product of experts. Financial views, loss weights and auxiliary outcomes are task-specific hypotheses.

papers.title: Retrieval & Fine-Tuning for In-Context Tabular Models
papers.use: Retrieval/context adaptation for tabular in-context models. Our fixed-cluster Kumo experts omit paper fine-tuning and are an extrapolation, not a reproduction.

papers.title: Example14.6 Survival Curve for Interval Censored Data
papers.use: Likelihood contribution S(lower)-S(upper), with right-censored S(censor). No exact historical event dates are invented.

data_policy: Supplied competition tables only; no borrower data uploaded to research services. Source motivation does not establish LOGIKA gains.
